findings.description: `holidays()` used to memoize per year. It now calls `self._source.holidays(...)` every time. `JsonHolidaySource.holidays` reads and parses the whole JSON file on each call. `is_business_day` calls `holidays()` once per day, so `add_business_days`, `business_days_between`, `roll_forward` and `SlaPolicy.overdue` do a disk read and JSON parse per day stepped. With `overdue` over many tickets, that means thousands of file reads.
findings.suggestion: Restore a per-year cache inside `BusinessCalendar` (keyed by year, since the calendar is already per region), or cache the parsed JSON in `JsonHolidaySource`.
findings.title: Per-year holiday cache removed, so the holiday file is re-read and re-parsed on every day check
